Apps in your fortress stay reachable while they reconnect, an action you start there runs once, and a sign-in service brings you back to CastleParcel behind a proxy that takes its path off.

## ⚡ Improved

- **ParleyPort 1.3.8.** Your fortress membership, sign-in and settings carry over as they are.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Opening another app in your fortress works while it reconnects.** An app drops off the relay for a moment when it joins again or gets a new name or address. Opening it, its status or an action in that moment ended in an error, also when its address turned the connection away.
- **An action runs once.** When its answer got lost on the way, the call could go out a second time over the relay and run the action twice.
- **A renamed app is back in the fortress list at once,** and an app that reconnects no longer shows as away.
- **Leaving the fortress is no longer taken for a removal,** and the other apps drop CastleParcel right away.
- **A sign-in service brings you back to CastleParcel below a path.** Behind a proxy that takes the path off before CastleParcel sees the request, the service sent the browser to the wrong place after signing in.
